# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1@sha256:87999aa3d42bdc6bea60565083ee17e86d1f3339802f543c0d03998580f9cb89

FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm-slim AS builder

RUN useradd -m bmi_user
USER bmi_user

ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1
ENV UV_LINK_MODE=copy
ENV UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=0

WORKDIR /app

ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/src

COPY ./src ./src
RUN touch /app/__init__.py
COPY pyproject.toml pyproject.toml
COPY README.md README.md
COPY uv.lock uv.lock

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \
    --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --locked --no-install-project --no-dev

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --locked --no-dev

# --- Test dependencies stage (for CI coverage) ---
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm-slim AS test-deps

# Install git (required by bmds_ki_validierung.ai_testing which uses GitPython)
# hadolint ignore=DL3008
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN useradd -m bmi_user
USER bmi_user

ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1
ENV UV_LINK_MODE=copy
ENV UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=0

WORKDIR /app

ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/src:/app

COPY ./src ./src
RUN touch /app/__init__.py
COPY pyproject.toml pyproject.toml
COPY README.md README.md
COPY uv.lock uv.lock
COPY tests ./tests
COPY scripts ./scripts
COPY example_data ./example_data

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \
    --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --locked --no-install-project --group test

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=UV_INDEX_USERNAME \
    --mount=type=secret,id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=UV_INDEX_PASSWORD \
    uv sync --locked --group test

ENV PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH"

# --- Final stage ---
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.12-bookworm-slim

USER 1001
# Set group to 0 for OCP compatibility

WORKDIR /app
# Copy application files with root ownership for container immutability
# SECURITY: chmod 755 = rwxr-xr-x (only root can write, others read+execute)
COPY --from=builder --chown=root:root --chmod=755 /app /app

ENV PATH="/root/.local/bin:/app/.venv/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

EXPOSE 8001

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=30s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8001/health || exit 1

ENTRYPOINT ["/app/.venv/bin/berichtskonfigurator"]
